verdict.rationale: The pack shows only general building blocks. These are a multichannel messaging API (twilio-docs-19), programmable voice that can answer calls without a person (twilio-docs-23), and a community mention of TwiML bins handling incoming SMS (twilio-comm-11). None of them documents a first-party auto-reply, scheduled-text, missed-call text-back or after-hours reply capability. Primitives a developer would have to assemble into these workflows earn no credit, and scheduled sending is not evidenced at all.
